extension.summary: Browse, play and manage your Filester cloud files
extension.description: Browse folders and files on Filester (u1.filester.me API v1), play videos with one click, search, sort, create / move / delete folders and files, set folder thumbnails, and view file details. Bring your own API key. Implements every endpoint in the Filester API reference: folders list, files list (with working pagination), folder/files listing, single-file details (slug), folder create, folder thumbnail upload, file+folder delete, file+folder move, public stream resolver, and public folder og:image thumbnails — including all documented workarounds (page-bug dedupe, midnight created_at sort tiebreak, identifier-vs-id, CDN cache-busting, expired-cert bypass, 429 backoff, client-side sorting).
extension.disclaimer: Requires a Filester API key. Unofficial addon — not affiliated with Filester.
